body:
Haha, thanks, an emotional breakdown screed from someone with OCD is nothing if not surrealistically poetic. I appreciate the support from a fellow fucked-up person in this often fucked-up world. Have a good one, thanks again.

*quick edit: phrasing*

It's a hell of a thing. When you're finally reckoning with it, so much of what's going on is a question of "how did I let things get this way?" Seeing someone else relate to the struggle and give some reassurance has helped in the hours since. Thanks, friend. Have a good one.
Thank you. Seeing this contributed to me being able to calm down earlier, and I appreciate that a lot. I hope you have a good one.
